title: post login with valid and invalid credentials
description: Test the POST /login endpoint with valid admin credentials to ensure it returns a 302 redirect to /dashboard and sets a session cookie. Also test with invalid credentials to verify it returns a 401 authentication error.

title: get dashboard with and without valid session
description: Test the GET /dashboard endpoint with a valid session cookie to receive a 200 dashboard page. Test without a session cookie to verify it redirects with a 302 to /login.

title: post shift open with and without existing open shift
description: Test the POST /shift/open endpoint with a valid session cookie to open a shift and receive a 200 response. Attempt to open a shift again when one is already open to verify it returns a 400 error indicating shift already open.

title: post api inventory add product with authorization and validation
description: Test the POST /api/inventory/add-product endpoint with admin credentials and valid product data to receive a 200 response with the created product. Test with cashier credentials to verify a 403 unauthorized error. Test with invalid data to receive a 400 validation error.

title: post api inventory adjust stock with validation and authorization
description: Test the POST /api/inventory/adjust-stock endpoint with admin credentials and valid stock adjustment data to receive a 200 response. Test with zero or negative change values to verify 400 validation errors. Test with cashier credentials to verify 403 unauthorized error.

title: post pos checkout with valid and invalid scenarios
description: Test the POST /pos/checkout endpoint with an open shift and valid payment totals to receive a 200 transaction success response. Test checkout without an open shift to receive a 400 business validation error. Test with payment amounts that do not sum to order total to verify a 400 payment mismatch error.

title: post api admin void order with role enforcement and error handling
description: Test the POST /api/admin/void-order endpoint with admin credentials and valid orderId to receive a 200 void success response. Test with cashier credentials to verify 403 unauthorized error. Test with a non-existent orderId to receive a 404 order not found error.

title: post api admin delete order with role enforcement and error handling
description: Test the POST /api/admin/delete-order endpoint with admin credentials and valid orderId to receive a 200 delete success response. Test with cashier credentials to verify 403 unauthorized error. Test with a non-existent orderId to receive a 404 order not found error.
